Game mode
Difficulty

Phone: left stick moves · drag the screen to look · JUMP / RUN / FLY buttons · FIRE, PLACE, BREAK, EAT appear per mode · 📜 quests · 🎒 backpack & crafting · ⏸ pause & graphics settings.
Desktop (primary): W A S D move · Mouse look (pointer lock, click the scene) · Click shoot / place (hold for full-auto) · Right-click ADS / scope · Space jump · Shift sprint · R reload · Q cycle weapon · 1–9 weapons in Survive (1 2 3 switch modes otherwise) · E interact / eat · F fly · Esc pause
Gun F1: Mouse wheel dial sniper magnification 4–12× · Shift (while scoped) hold breath · [ ] adjust zero · X press check · G mag check · V inspect · B fire-mode selector · H safety · N suppressor on/off · T tap-rack (clear a misfire)

Install: Share → Add to Home Screen for the full app experience.
